panels.title: Disk IO Wait Time

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_weighted_io_time | avg by host

panels.description: This value counts the number of milliseconds that I/O requests have waited on this block device. If there are multiple I/O requests waiting, this value will increase as the product of the number of milliseconds times the number of requests waiting (see read_time above for an example).

panels.title: Disk Free Space Over Time

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*disk_free | avg by host

panels.description: This value counts the number of milliseconds that I/O requests have waited on this block device. If there are multiple I/O requests waiting, this value will increase as the product of the number of milliseconds times the number of requests waiting (see read_time above for an example).

panels.description: This value counts the number of milliseconds that I/O requests have waited on this block device. panels.description: This value counts the number of milliseconds that I/O requests have waited on this block device. If there are multiple I/O requests waiting, this value will increase as the product of the number of milliseconds times the number of requests waiting (see read_time above for an example).

panels.title: Disk Read Vs Write Time

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_read_time | avg by host
_sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}} metric=*diskio_write_time | avg by host

panels.description: These values count the number of milliseconds that I/O requests have waited on this block device. If there are multiple I/O requests waiting, these values will increase at a rate greater than 1000/second; for example, if 60 read requests wait for an average of 30 ms, the read_time field will increase by 60*30 = 1800.

panels.title: Disk Read Vs Write Bytes

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_read_bytes  | avg by host
_sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}} metric=*diskio_write_bytes  | avg by host

panels.description: These values count the number of bytes read from or written to this block device.

panels.title: IOPs in Progress Count

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_iops_in_progress   | avg by host

panels.description: This value counts the number of I/O requests that have been issued to the device driver but have not yet completed. It does not include I/O requests that are in the queue but not yet issued to the device driver.

panels.title: Disk Merged Reads Vs Writes

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_merged_reads | avg by host
_sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}}  metric=*diskio_merged_writes | avg by host

panels.description: Reads and writes which are adjacent to each other may be merged for efficiency. Thus two 4K reads may become one 8K read before it is ultimately handed to the disk, and so it will be counted (and queued) as only one I/O. These fields lets you know how often this was done.

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Kafka* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} host={{Server}} metric=*disk_used_percent | avg by host
